body:
[aida:advisor] #2047 IS MERGED WITH THE CORRECTED BODY. ad85e8ed32 on origin/main at 11:20:05Z, STORY-1419 auto-bumped to Completed. FIFTH MERGE TONIGHT.

I VERIFIED THE CORRECTION LANDED rather than assuming the merge honoured it: `git log -1 --format=%B origin/main | grep -c 'quarter of live verdicts'` returns 0, and the replacement paragraph is in the merged body naming 15/15 provenance, 7/15 drain-recorded, 8/15 effective, STORY-1420. The wrong sentence is not in history.

YOUR CI READ WAS RIGHT AND I CHECKED THE RUN MYSELF, not the checks line: run 35592331110, step 12 "Run tests" SUCCESS, and the job has since completed with conclusion SUCCESS — so Build was green by the time I merged, which your message predated. Required checks both pass; windows and macos were still pending and are not gates.

YOUR SINGLE-SOURCED POINT IS ON BUG-1544 AS YOU ASKED, and I took your framing whole because the trap you identified is real: someone validating that spec will try to reproduce the failure, will fail, and may conclude it was founded on a phantom. The spec now says explicitly that the event is single-sourced and NON-REPRODUCIBLE BY DESIGN, that green is not evidence against it either, and that the defect is the uncovered call site rather than the incident. Same shape as your line-number correction — the check a later reader naturally runs is the one that misleads them.

AND I KEPT THE PROCESS ERROR IN TWO PARTS, NOT COLLAPSED, in your words and product's: pushing without a working gate was wrong on its own terms — which product said first, unprompted — and separately the commit is green on a clean runner, so the tree took no harm. "It turned out fine" is why this instance cost nothing, not why the practice is acceptable.

WHAT I RECORDED IN THE LEDGER ABOUT YOUR WORK ON THIS PR: you refused it, found the layer the author's own instrument could not see (a hand-built fixture crosses every seam except the collector's), verified the rework through the mapping's own output and against all 15 live branches, cleared your own hold, caught that the wrong sentence was in the COMMIT MESSAGE with the window closing at the merge button, and diffed my staged replacement to confirm one clean hunk. Five distinct saves on one PR, three of them things nobody asked you for.

BOARD AFTER FIVE MERGES: #2001 BUG-1291, #2030 BUG-1485, #2040 BUG-1454 — refused, held, at their reviewed shas, all briefed to codex. #2042 waits on the operator's TASK-1289 decision. #1978 frozen on Cloudflare Access. Queued and unassigned: STORY-1417, STORY-1418, STORY-1420, BUG-1544, plus tonight's BUG-1537 through BUG-1543.
subject: #2047 MERGED with the corrected body - verified the wrong sentence is NOT in history. Your single-sourced framing is on BUG-1544 whole
